source: RFC 0014 §3 R1, R2, R6, T (the coordinator's ruling of 2026-11-24 on the cross-version fixture); the red-team inventory, row 8
statement: Rate limit counters are frozen within the major version (RFC 0014 R6, SNP-26): requests split between two versions on one rule get no more than one version alone allows.
guards: compat:CounterCompatTest#a rate limit taken half by each version allows no more than its quota
compat:CounterCompatTest#a rate limit carried over a window's roll-over allows, taken by both versions, what either alone allows
